# A session with the keeper, one call a line. A line that starts with "!" is
# something that happens by itself: a window of that size attaches, a pane's
# program ends, or the next program fails to start.

# Before any window: no pane has a place yet, and no split is refused.
{"op":"version"}
{"op":"snapshot"}
{"op":"status"}
{"op":"tab-create","label":"fix login bug","cwd":"/work/app","env":["COLOUR=teal"]}
{"op":"tab-create","label":"write the tests","cwd":"/work/site"}
{"op":"screen","pane":"p1"}
{"op":"screen","pane":"p2"}
{"op":"size","pane":"p1"}
{"op":"split","pane":"p1","dir":"right","ratio":0.7}
{"op":"split","pane":"p1","dir":"down","ratio":4}
{"op":"screen","pane":"p3"}
{"op":"screen","pane":"p4"}
{"op":"snapshot"}

# The keys.

{"op":"pane-focus","pane":"p3","dir":"left"}
{"op":"pane-focus","pane":"p1","dir":"down"}
{"op":"pane-focus","pane":"p4","dir":"up"}
{"op":"pane-focus","pane":"p4"}
{"op":"pane-focus","pane":"p2"}
{"op":"pane-focus","pane":"p1","dir":"sideways"}
{"op":"tab-focus","tab":"t1"}
{"op":"tab-focus","tab":"t1"}
{"op":"tab-rename","tab":"t2","label":"tests for login"}
{"op":"snapshot"}

# What is refused.

# A program of ours in a pane, in place of the shell.
{"op":"swap","pane":"p1","target":"p3"}
{"op":"run","pane":"p3","argv":["whaleshark","ui","run","fleet"]}
{"op":"screen","pane":"p3"}
{"op":"snapshot"}
!fail
{"op":"run","pane":"p4","argv":["missing"]}
{"op":"screen","pane":"p4"}
!fail
{"op":"tab-create","label":"never"}
!fail
{"op":"split","pane":"p2","dir":"left"}
{"op":"snapshot"}

# A second window of another size: the panes take the size of the one used last.
!window 60 20
{"op":"status"}
{"op":"size","pane":"p2"}
{"op":"size","pane":"p5"}

{"op":"screen","pane":"p5"}

{"op":"status"}

# An agent in a pane, a pane drawn over the tab, and the calls an agent may
# not make from its own pane.
{"op":"agent-start","name":"quiet otter","kind":"claude","pane":"p9","argv":["--model","small"]}
{"op":"overlay","argv":["whaleshark","ui","run","actions"],"w":0.5,"h":0.5}

{"op":"snapshot","from":"p9"}
